mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 units in a month signals weak residential construction, which reduces economic activity and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST falls below 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a contraction in the real economy, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: In an economic expansion (GDPC1 growth above 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0%), INDPRO decline below 95.0 is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.
